title: k-Nearest Neighbors Classifier by Hand
learning_objectives: Classify by majority vote of the k nearest training points
Break distance and vote ties deterministically
See how k trades bias and variance
hints: Compute the (n_test, n_train) squared-distance matrix with broadcasting (NP-11).
For each row: `order = np.argsort(d_row, kind='stable')[:k]`; `labels = y_train[order]`.
Count votes in neighbour order; pick the label with the max count, scanning `labels` left to right for ties.

failure_feedback.advice: Vote among the k nearest *training points*, not class means.
On a vote tie pick the tied label that appears first in neighbour (distance) order.
Use np.argsort(..., kind='stable') so equal distances keep training order.
Nearest centroid would predict differently here — vote among neighbours.
